column1: We are called to be God's people
Are you washed in the blood?
Are you coming to Jesus tonight?
Christ the Lord is risen today
He is able to deliver thee
He knows just what I need
I am coming to the cross
I gave my life for thee
I heard the voice of Jesus say
I know not why God's wondrous grace
If I have wound any soul
Is thy heart right with God
Let him have his way with thee
Let the lower lights be burning
My faith looks up to Thee
None of self and all of Thee
O listen to our wondrous story
O master let me walk with Thee
Savior grant me rest and peace
Savior like a shepherd lead us
Soul a Savior thou art needing
There is power in the blood
Though your sins be as scarlet
What will you do with Jesus?
When I survey the wondrous cross
Who at the door is standing?
While we pray and while we plead
Will you not tell it today?
Why did my Savior come to earth?
